caption:
Koko's program is stuck on the fridge, and the exercises are always starting tomorrow. It may not be a willpower problem.

Linking your exercises to something you already do, like brushing your teeth or waiting for the kettle, makes them far easier to remember. Three exercises you actually do beat eight you skip, and it's fine to ask for a shorter list.

Film each exercise during your visit, tick a calendar and bring your tally next time. If an exercise hurts more or doesn't fit your week, tell us so the plan can change. Our physios, chiropractors and Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
